title: File federal tax return
summary: Prepare the annual federal corporate tax return (Form 1120) and file with the IRS.

parts.title: Export financial data from QBO
parts.guidance: Export the trial balance, financial statements and transaction detail requested for the entity, period and accounting basis. Reconcile reports to the closed books and bank records, and identify late adjustments or incomplete schedules. Use consistent date filters and report versions so totals reconcile across the exports.

parts.title: Send financials to CPA
parts.guidance: Send the preparer the reconciled exports, prior returns, ownership information and requested transaction records through the agreed secure channel. Include unusual events and known gaps explicitly. Keep an index of what was sent and use a single point of contact for questions and revised files so the final return can be traced to the supplied facts.

parts.title: CPA prepares return (2-3 weeks)
parts.guidance: Answer the preparer’s questions with verified records and review proposed adjustments and elections. Identify unresolved issues, attachments and separate filing or payment dates for this entity. Compare drafts when material figures change. Preparation is ready for review when the return and supporting explanations are complete enough to decide the outstanding items; use the engagement’s actual timing estimate.

options.title: Default — CPA prepares return (2-3 weeks)
options.summary: Work with the engaged CPA on the agreed returns, elections and schedules for this entity and year. Supply reconciled records and answer questions, then review proposed adjustments and remaining issues. Confirm who handles signature authorization, transmission and payment under the engagement so preparation can move into filing without an unassigned responsibility.

options.title: Startup tax platform
options.summary: Check that the tax service supports the entity, ownership structure, states, elections and unusual transactions involved. Compare preparation and review responsibility, question handling, price and exclusions. Provide records through its secure process, then reconcile the draft to the books and obtain the required signature authorization. Check imported figures and resulting tax treatment before authorizing filing.
options.when: No CPA relationship - a startup tax platform prepares and files the return

parts.title: Review draft return
parts.guidance: Compare the draft with final books, carryforwards, ownership records and significant transactions. Review tax adjustments, elections, related-party reporting and estimated payments with the preparer. Resolve unfamiliar figures and verify the entity and period before approving the exact return version through the company’s filing process. Treat any payment instruction as a distinct decision.

parts.title: Officer signs the e-file authorization (Form 8879-CORP)
parts.guidance: For a return using Form 8879-CORP, the authorized corporate officer reviews the complete electronic return before signing. Verify the corporation, year, required return figures and any electronic-withdrawal consent against the reviewed draft. Resolve changes with the electronic return originator, then sign and return the authorization securely. Keep it associated with the return it authorizes.

parts.title: CPA files return with IRS
parts.guidance: Confirm the preparer has the approved return and required signature authorization before transmission. Obtain the filing acknowledgement and distinguish acceptance from rejection. Resolve rejected submissions promptly, reviewing material corrections before retransmission. Preserve the filed return and acceptance, and check any separately required forms or attachments the preparer identified.

verify.how: The IRS e-file acceptance acknowledgment comes back through the CPA — retain it with the signed copy of the return.

parts.title: Pay any tax due
parts.guidance: Reconcile the balance due with credits, estimated payments and any electronic withdrawal already authorized. Verify taxpayer, period, payment type, amount and due date with the preparer. Use the company’s payment-approval process and check settlement. Match any debit included with filing before paying again, and resolve failed or missing payments against the tax account.

verify.how: IRS Direct Pay or EFTPS issues a payment confirmation number and the payment posts to the business tax account.

parts.title: File copy in records
parts.guidance: File the submitted return, schedules, elections, signature authorization, acceptance and payment evidence together. Keep supporting workpapers and explanations of material positions, with drafts clearly separate. Apply the relevant retention and access arrangements so a new preparer can understand the filed position and any later notice or amendment can be investigated.

metadata.supportReason: Tax filing requires a CPA. System compiles financial data, tracks deadlines, coordinates with accountant.

geoNotes.summary: Companies file the ITR-6 return electronically on the Income Tax e-filing portal; the tax year runs April–March rather than the calendar year.
The company files a CT600 Company Tax Return with HMRC within 12 months of its accounting period end — plus statutory accounts to Companies House.
Corporation tax (Körperschaftsteuer) plus trade tax (Gewerbesteuer) returns are filed electronically through ELSTER, in practice via a Steuerberater.
Corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) is declared and paid through the company's espace professionnel on impots.gouv.fr.

The company files the Modelo 22 (IRC) return electronically through the Portal das Finanças by the end of May for calendar-year companies, plus the IES annual declaration — in practice via a certified accountant (contabilista certificado).

The company files a T2 corporation income tax return with the CRA within six months of its fiscal year-end (tax owing is due earlier), plus any provincial corporate returns outside the CRA-administered provinces.
